name: dropdown
title: Dropdown
description: Trigger button + action menu panel using ARIA menu/menuitem semantics. Owns the shared menu primitives (Dropdown.Item / Dropdown.Separator / Dropdown.Group) reused by context-menu and split-button. Roving tabindex, Arrow/Home/End + first-character typeahead, Enter/Space activation, Escape, Tab dismissal, outside-click, and viewport-flip placement, ported 1:1 from hbd-dropdown.js + menu-controller.js.
